title: Journey to Japan | Group Tour Package
highlights: Explore Japan's dynamic allure, where ancient traditions blend with modern innovations against a backdrop of scenic landscapes and bustling city life.
Marvel at the Hill of Buddha in Sapporo, home to a towering 13.5-meter tall statue of Buddha and set against Hokkaido's stunning landscapes.
Discover Takkoku no Iwaya in Hiraizumi, where ancient Buddhist statues are carved into cliffs, reflecting Japan's rich spiritual heritage.
Visit Tokyo's iconic Meiji Shrine to admire its exquisite architecture, and witness traditional rituals surrounded by serene forests.
Ascend Goryokaku Tower for the panoramic view of Goryokaku Park, a unique star-shaped fort built in the 19th century.
inclusions: Transfer from Narita International Airport to Shinagawa Prince Hotel, Tokyo

know_before_you_go: All visitors need to carry a valid ID Proof.
Remove shoes before entering homes or certain traditional temples.
Purchase a Japan Rail Pass if traveling extensively by train. Familiarize yourself with local train and bus routes.
Learning basic Japanese phrases or using a translation app can be helpful.
While credit cards are becoming more accepted, many places still prefer cash. ATMs that accept foreign cards are available at convenience stores and post offices.
Tipping is not customary in Japan and may be considered rude. Instead, show appreciation through polite behavior and gratitude.
Follow local customs, such as not pointing feet, maintaining quiet in public places, and respecting religious sites.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Leisure Time in Shinjuku District
days.desc: Welcome to Tokyo! Upon arrival at the airport, you'll be transferred to your hotel. Check-in and rest for some time. Later, get driven to the Tokyo Metro to board your train to Shibuya District. There, you can explore the trendy shops and lively streets, and don’t miss the chance to experience the high-energy environment of Shibuya Crossing. Later, find serenity at Shinjuku Gyoen Park. Next, take the metro back to Tokyo Station, and get driven back to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

items.title: Check-in at Shinagawa Prince Hotel, Tokyo

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, get driven on a guided tour of Tokyo. Start with the panoramic views of Tokyo Tower from the historic Zojoji Temple. Next, find serenity at Meiji Shrine and explore the fashionable Omotesando. Admire the grandeur of the Imperial Palace and Nijubashi Bridge, and dive into Akihabara's vibrant anime culture. Visit the renowned Kokugikan Sumo Stadium, and delve into the rich history of Sensoji Temple. Conclude with Nakamise shopping street in Asakusa and get transferred back to your hotel.

days.title: Transfer to Sendai via Nikko | Nikko Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Post check out, get driven to Sendai with a scenic stop in Nikko. Begin your exploration at the famed Toshogu Shrine, known for its intricate design and the unique Crying Dragon carving. Next, enjoy a peaceful walk along the Kanmangafuchi Abyss, where you can admire the serene Jizo statues lining the path. Upon arrival in Sendai, check into your hotel and spend the rest of your day at leisure. You can visit Aobayama Park and Zuihoden Temple. Later, return to your hotel.

items.title: Check-in at Hotel Metropolitan Sendai East

days.title: Transfer to Morioka | Visit to Kanrantei Tea House, Matsushima Bay Cruise and Hiraizumi Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: After checking out from your hotel, get driven to Morioka, with a stop at Matsushima along the way. At Kanrantei Tea House, savor the renowned Matcha Tea before embarking on a scenic cruise around Matsushima Bay to take in its stunning landmarks. Next, make a stop in Hiraizumi, where you'll visit the historic temples of Motsuji and Chuson-ji, and marvel at the UNESCO-listed Takkoku no Iwaya. Finally, get driven to Morioka, check in to your hotel, and enjoy a comfortable overnight stay.

items.title: Check-in at Hotel Metropolitan Morioka New Wing

days.title: Transfer to Hakodate | Visit to Hirosaki Castle | Explore Nebuta Museum
days.desc: Today, check out from your hotel and board your transfer to Hakodate. Along the way, stop in Hirosaki to explore the historic Hirosaki Castle. Continue your journey with a visit to the Nebuta Museum in Aomori, where you can indulge yourself in traditional Japanese culture. Afterward, take a ferry to Hokkaido Island. Upon arrival in Hakodate, enjoy free time to explore the city center and its notable attractions. Later, check into your hotel and rest for a comfortable overnight stay.

items.title: Check-in at Premier Hotel - Cabin President - Hakodate

days.title: Transfer to Sapporo | Visit Goryokaku Tower & Oyunuma Lake | Leisure time in Onuma National Park
days.desc: Post check out, get transferred to Sapporo. En route, make a stop at Goryokaku Tower in Hakodate, where you can ascend to the observation deck and admire the unique star-shaped fortress. Continue your journey with a visit to Onuma National Park, where you can take a leisurely stroll around its serene lake. Next, get driven to Noboribetsu Jigokudani to marvel at the striking Oyunuma Hot Spring Pond. Finally, arrive in Sapporo, check into your hotel, and rest for the night.

items.title: Leisure Time in Onuma Quasi National Park

days.title: Sapporo Sightseeing Tour | Visit to Hill Of Buddha | Leisure Time in Otaru
days.desc: Today, get driven for a Sapporo sightseeing tour. Start your day at the iconic Sapporo Clock Tower, then enjoy a leisurely stroll through the lush Odori Park. Next, experience a traditional Kito ceremony at Hokkaido Jingu Shrine, and witness the impressive Big Buddha statue. Then, visit the Hill of Buddha to see the Moai replicas. Continue to Otaru, where you can wander along the charming Otaru Canal and visit the serene Ryugu Shrine. Afterwards, get driven to your hotel.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check-out from your hotel and continue your journey back home on your own. This marks the end of your trip.
